pins.issue: Footprint R_0402_1005Metric fits the 1.0x0.5 mm body. Note (not a pin issue): at 25 C with VBUS 5.0-5.5 V the R39/(TH1||R40) divider puts ~3.1-3.4 V across TH1, ~0.31-0.34 mA, at or slightly above the 0.31 mA "permissible operating current" (defined in the catalogue as the current that keeps self-heating to max 1 C). Expect ~1 C self-heating bias in the TEMP window.
